revision: third pass -- role structure confirmed as the official TRAIN/DEV/TEST split with no fourth operational split, TEST terminology corrected away from 'blind'/'unseen' -- see docs/evaluation_protocol.md Part 1 sections 2-4

code_changes_first_correction_pass.evaluation/metrics.py::joint_label_evide: NotMentioned case now also requires empty retrieved_span_indices to count as jointly correct (previously any correct-NotMentioned label passed regardless of claimed evidence -- a real gap, since ContractNLI provides zero gold evidence for NotMentioned by definition, so any claimed evidence there is fabricated).
code_changes_first_correction_pass.evaluation/metrics.py::recall_with_ci: new generic per-class recall+CI function, added instead of a bespoke not_mentioned_recall_with_ci(); contradiction_recall_with_ci() now delegates to it (recall_with_ci(Label.CONTRADICTION, ...)), same return shape, verified identical via test.

code_changes_second_correction_pass.evaluation/schemas.py: Prediction.split and GoldCase.split added, both str default '' -- purely additive, does not break loading historical JSONL result files (missing field uses default).
code_changes_second_correction_pass.evaluation/metrics.py::_case_key: new helper, returns (split, doc_id, hypothesis_id); split defaults to '' so historical records (which never set it) match exactly as before.
code_changes_second_correction_pass.evaluation/metrics.py::_match_prediction: now keys via _case_key() instead of a bare (doc_id, hypothesis_id) tuple -- split-qualified when split is set, legacy-compatible when it isn't.

evidence_threshold_audit.stage_1_chunk_to_span_mapping: evaluation/scorer.py map_chunks_to_gold_span_indices() -- binary any-character-overlap rule, span_start < chunk.end_char and span_end > chunk.start_char; not containment; verified via 7 existing tests in tests/test_scorer.py
evidence_threshold_audit.stage_2_recall_threshold: evaluation/metrics.py -- recall = |gold_span_index_set intersect retrieved_span_index_set| / |gold_span_index_set|; tau_evidence default 0.5 compared against this per-case fraction
evidence_threshold_audit.numerator: count of gold span indices also present in the retrieved set
evidence_threshold_audit.denominator: total count of gold span indices for that case (never the retrieved count)
evidence_threshold_audit.gold_span_count_distribution_note: 43.7% of Entailment/Contradiction test cases have exactly 1 gold span (tau=0.5 equivalent to requiring full coverage for these); mean approx 2.02 spans/case
evidence_threshold_audit.conclusion: tau=0.5 acts as a majority-of-gold-spans rule for n>=2, full-coverage requirement for n=1 -- a defensible interim default, but NOT scientifically frozen. Frozen: explicit evidence identification, the two-stage matching semantics, the set-based recall calculation, and the joint metric's structure. NOT frozen: the exact tau=0.5 value -- evidence_recall_threshold=0.5 is kept only as the historical/interim configured default. E06 may investigate/sensitivity-test tau using TRAIN development data. The final tau must be frozen before architecture comparison/final TEST. Do not use TEST to select tau.

not_mentioned_evidence_policy.classification_metrics: correct label is sufficient, no evidence check
not_mentioned_evidence_policy.joint_metric_revised: correct label AND no evidence claimed/returned (retrieved_span_indices empty) required for joint PASS -- fabricated evidence on a correct NotMentioned label now fails the joint check

a0_a1_evidence_identification_policy.decision: rejected the historical convention that full-context 'sees everything' automatically satisfies the joint metric's evidence requirement
a0_a1_evidence_identification_policy.new_policy: every architecture (A0-A3) must explicitly identify the evidence span/clause IDs it relied on; joint metric is computed only from identified evidence, never from evidence merely being present somewhere in model context
a0_a1_evidence_identification_policy.implementation_status: NOT built this phase (no pipeline/model code changed, per instructions). pipeline/classifier.py (A1) and pipeline/rule_baseline.py (A0) do not yet produce identified evidence under this policy -- flagged as a real blocker for E12, to be resolved in E04/E05

case_id_scheme.status: frozen for all future reconstruction-v2 manifests, and NOW IMPLEMENTED in evaluation/schemas.py and evaluation/metrics.py._match_predictions_to_golds() -- legacy records (split='') match exactly as before, split-qualified records only match other records with the identical split explicitly set. No manifests generated yet -- this is matching infrastructure ready for when they are.

split_role_structure.final_decision: official ContractNLI three-way split used as-is -- TRAIN (Role A: all development/tuning -- Oracle, model screening, prompt selection, retrieval tuning, agent development; fixed TRAIN subsets only for cost/runtime-controlled diagnostics), DEV (Role B: validation and architecture/configuration selection, used only after candidate configs are sufficiently frozen from TRAIN development; freeze the configuration before TEST), TEST (Role C: final held-out benchmark under the reconstruction-v2 protocol, no tuning after viewing results). No fourth operational split.
split_role_structure.historical_exposure: DEV's and TEST's historical exposure is disclosed in docs/data_contamination_register.md as a methodological limitation of the historical T-series work, not treated as disqualifying either split from its standard role.
split_role_structure.test_terminology: TEST is referred to as 'the final held-out benchmark under the reconstruction-v2 protocol', never as 'blind' or 'perfectly unseen', because historical T-series runs already scored against it (disclosed, not undoable).
